content: We collected a corpus for our LM based on Spanish Twitter using tweepy run for three 4-hour sessions and collecting any tweet with any of the terms 'el','su','lo','y' or 'en'. We excluded retweets to minimize repeated examples in our language model training. In total, we collected 475,143 tweets - a data set is nearly 16 times larger than the text provided by the competition alone. The frequency of terms, punctuation and vocabulary used on Twitter can be quite different from the standard Wikipedia corpus that is often used to train an LM from scratch.
